terms.gloss: something to listen to: a podcast
terms.comment: Our choice: no reference work has a word for a podcast. The Greek-Latin ācroāma is “that which is heard with pleasure”, music or a reading given to entertain guests at dinner (Lewis & Short); at Atticus’ table the only ācroāma was a reader (Nep. Att. 14.1). It names a podcast by what one does with it: listen. Classically also the performer himself (Cic. Sest. 54, Lewis & Short).
The international word, which a Latin speaker will be understood to mean.

sources: No source has a word for a podcast.
